display_title: Do You Want to Be Friends Forever?
description:
Lee Ju-Yeong (female, 30), whose behavior is unpredictable, is a lifelong single and a staunch advocate of non-romance. Yet, she receives a proposal to work on an adult romance webtoon.

 *'But how on earth do you draw sex and dating?!'*

Desperate to gain sexual creative inspiration, she abruptly proposes a one-night stand to her upstairs friend, Lee Do-Yeong (male, 30)?! Do-yeong is a devoted man who has harbored a crush on Ju-Yeong for a long time, and he is at a loss as she relentlessly strips off his pants.

 *"Hey, Lee Ju-Yeong, snap out of it."

"Can't you just... do it just once? I... I want to sleep with a guy..."* 

Will Lee Do-Yeong's innocence be able to survive against this bulldozer-like Lee Ju-Yeong?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
